observation: A202 3/A202 omitted two wall-light silhouettes even though the source dimensioned their offset, center spacing and height.
cause: The simplified lighting omission rule treated all lights as decorative and did not distinguish dimensioned coordination fixtures from undimensioned glow or texture.
proposed_rule: A non-cabinet fixture or light may be omitted only when it is decorative, undimensioned and outside coordination scope. If its outline, position or spacing is dimensioned or provides a required witness, retain a simplified source-bound silhouette and complete dimensions; keep unmeasured physical size provisional and never turn it into cabinet geometry.
limits: A202 fixture coordinates and native IDs remain project facts. The calibrated ring diameter/depth are illustrative and not manufacturer or fabrication specifications. This does not approve A202 or unseen customer drawings.
